$comment: Azure AI Foundry OpenAPI tool for the Algenta Decision API, in the CURRENT Foundry OpenApiFunctionDefinition shape (type + openapi{name,description,spec,auth}). Foundry has NO spec_url field: run build_tool.py to fetch the gateway's reduced spec, force HTTPS, drop the API-key scheme, and emit decision-tool.deploy.json with openapi.spec inlined. Audience is the gateway app-registration Application ID URI.

openapi.name: algenta_decision_api
openapi.description: Coarse governed-decision operations: frame a decision, run the analysis (async), read the result, inspect evidence, propose a plan, record an outcome. Approval and execution are NOT available here — they are separate, credentialed human actions.
